item.description:

Jordan and Iraq jointly blocked Telegram over national security and regulatory concerns, and the US consulate is conducting security tests in Erbil. Baghdad and Iran reached a deal for Kataib Hezbollah to leave Jurf al-Sakhar, and a former hostage said she was held in a militia stronghold targeted by the prime minister. item.description:

The RSF continues to conduct drone strikes on civilian populations and power stations, causing darkness and civilian casualties, including children, and the UN reports that drones account for nearly three-quarters of Sudan war deaths this year. A former Sudanese information minister was attacked in Uganda, and a former Sudanese official wanted by the ICC was arrested, confirming U.S. involvement. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
